Definition

Let $S\subseteq M$ be an immersed or embedded submanifold, possibly with boundary. A vector field $X$ on $M$ is tangent to $S$ at $p\in S$ if $X_p\in T_pS\subseteq T_pM$, and it is tangent to $S$ if this holds at every point of $S$.
